definition_zh: 打开；拆开（包装）；解开（覆盖层）；揭露（真相）；放松、不再紧张
definition_en: to remove the paper, plastic, or cloth that covers something, or to open up what has been folded or held tight
core_image: 手指勾住包装纸的边角，一圈圈撕开，里面的东西终于露出来
scene: 圣诞节清晨，孩子抱着礼盒坐在树下，屏住呼吸等待拆开。The child tore the ribbon off and began to unwrap the present.
sceneCN: 这里 unwrap 是「拆开包装」（第 1 个义项：打开、拆去包装）；句意：孩子扯掉丝带，开始拆开礼物。

pos.zh: 打开；拆开（包装）；揭开（覆盖物）
散开；松开（指包装、绷带自行动开）

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「包裹、缠住」；加前缀 un- 反向构成 unwrap
现在分词转名词，义为「拆包；揭开」的动作或过程
wrap 加 -ing 构成，义为「包装材料」；与 unwrap 形成动作的反向对照
wrap 加 -er 构成，义为「包装纸、封套」；正是 unwrap 时被撕去的部分

senses.title: To remove a covering
senses.definition: to take off the paper, plastic, or other covering from something
senses.definitionCN: 去掉某物外面的纸、塑料或其他覆盖层
senses.example: She unwrapped the scarf and put it on at once.
senses.exampleCN: 她拆开围巾的包装，马上就戴上了。
senses.why: Wrap means to cover something by folding material round it, and un- reverses the act, so unwrap pulls the covering off again.
senses.whyCN: wrap 是把材料一圈圈裹上，前缀 un- 表示反向动作，所以 unwrap 就是把包裹层一层层取下来。

senses.title: To undo a bandage or binding
senses.definition: to loosen and remove a bandage, string, or band that has been wound around a part of the body or an object
senses.definitionCN: 松开并取掉缠在身体部位或物体上的绷带、绳子或绑带
senses.example: The nurse unwrapped the bandage to check the cut.
senses.exampleCN: 护士解开绷带查看伤口。
senses.why: The old sense of wrap is to wind round, so unwrap also means to wind the binding back off a limb or a parcel.
senses.whyCN: wrap 的古义是「缠绕」，因此 unwrap 也指把缠在肢体或包裹上的东西一圈圈绕下来。

senses.title: To open up what is folded
senses.definition: to spread out something that has been folded, rolled, or tucked in
senses.definitionCN: 把折叠、卷起或收拢的东西铺开
senses.example: He unwrapped the map across the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他把地图在桌上摊开。
senses.why: Folding is a kind of wrapping round the object itself, so opening it out is the same release of a covering.
senses.whyCN: 折叠等于把物体自身裹起来，把折痕摊开，就是同一种「解开覆盖」的动作。

senses.title: To reveal a hidden fact
senses.definition: to make known something that has been kept hidden or unclear
senses.definitionCN: 把被隐藏或不清楚的事情公开出来
senses.example: The report unwrapped the secret behind the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告揭开了交易背后的秘密。
senses.why: The image of taking off paper is transferred to information, so a hidden truth is figuratively unwrapped layer by layer.
senses.whyCN: 把「撕去包装纸」的画面移到信息上，被藏起来的真相就像包裹一样被一层层揭开。

senses.title: To become relaxed
senses.definition: to relax and stop being tense, formal, or defensive
senses.definitionCN: 放松下来，不再紧张、拘谨或戒备
senses.example: After the first joke he began to unwrap a little.
senses.exampleCN: 听完第一个笑话，他开始稍微放松下来。
senses.why: Emotional tension is pictured as a binding layer, and unwrapping lets the real person show through.
senses.whyCN: 情绪上的紧张被想象成缠在身上的一层束缚，unwrap 就是把这一层解开，让真实的自己露出来。

intro.en: Unwrap is an English compound of the prefix un-, meaning not or the reverse of an action, and the verb wrap, whose older senses included to wind or roll and to cover.
intro.cn: unwrap 是英语内部构成的复合词：前缀 un- 表示「相反」，加上动词 wrap（缠绕、包裹）。

items.en: The verb wrappen appears in Middle English with the sense of winding cloth round something.
items.cn: 中古英语中出现动词 wrappen，意为把布缠绕在某物上。

items.en: The deeper origin of wrap is uncertain; some writers link it to a Scandinavian source, but the evidence is not secure.
items.cn: wrap 更早的来源不确定，有说法认为与斯堪的纳维亚语有关，但证据不足。

items.en: Un- as a reversing prefix combines with verbs such as tie and cover, giving a systematic family of undo verbs.
items.cn: 表示反向的 un- 与 tie、cover 等动词构成成体系的一类「解除动作」动词。

items.en: Unwrap settles into the everyday sense of taking a covering off a parcel or present.
items.cn: 现代英语中 unwrap 固定为日常义「拆开包裹或礼物」。

items.en: Modern computing adds unwrap for removing an outer dependency or container, as in unwrapping a package.
items.cn: 现代计算机术语中，unwrap 又指剥去外层依赖或容器，例如解开一个软件包。

note.en: Unwrap belongs to the un- family of reversing prefixes and sits next to wrap, wrapper, and the near meanings open, undo, and peel.
note.cn: unwrap 属于 un- 反向前缀家族，与 wrap、wrapper 形式相关，意义上的邻居是 open、undo、peel。

entries.definition: to cover something by folding paper or material round it
the paper or plastic that covers something
to take things out of a bag or case
to move something so that it is no longer closed
to unfasten or loosen something that is tied
to remove the outer skin or layer of something

normalIntro.en: Unwrap is the reversing twin of wrap: if wrap puts paper round a thing, unwrap takes the paper off again.
normalIntro.cn: unwrap 是 wrap 的反向双生词：wrap 用纸把东西裹起来，unwrap 就把纸再剥下来。

normal.en: The un- in unwrap is the same reversing prefix seen in unlock and unbutton.
normal.cn: unwrap 中的 un- 与 unlock、unbutton 里表示反向的前缀相同。

normal.en: The past form unwrapped doubles the final p, like wrapped.
normal.cn: 过去式 unwrapped 与 wrapped 一样，词尾 p 要双写。

normal.en: A wrapper is what you take off, so unwrap and wrapper share the covering picture.
normal.cn: wrapper 就是被取下的那层包装，unwrap 与 wrapper 共享「覆盖物」的画面。

normal.en: Unwrap a present pairs with birthday, Christmas, and gift.
normal.cn: unwrap a present 常与生日、圣诞节、礼物等场合搭配。

normal.en: In computing, unwrapping a package means peeling off its outer layer as well.
normal.cn: 在计算机里 unwrap a package 也指剥掉软件包的外层。

abstract.en: Picture a paper cone unwrapping itself and letting the sweet inside show.
abstract.cn: 想象一只纸包自己松开，露出里面的糖果。

abstract.en: Imagine a rolled-up bandage being wound back off a wrist.
abstract.cn: 想象一卷绷带从手腕上一圈圈绕下来。

abstract.en: Think of a folded map opening out like a flower in a hurry.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折叠的地图像花一样迅速展开。

examples.en: Please unwrap the parcel carefully so that the box stays undamaged.
examples.cn: 请小心拆开包裹，别弄坏盒子。

examples.en: She unwrapped the chocolate bar and shared it with the children.
examples.cn: 她拆开巧克力，分给了孩子们。

examples.en: The technician had to unwrap the package twice before the error message disappeared.
examples.cn: 技术员不得不把软件包解压两次，错误提示才消失。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安瑞普」——把外面的皮一层层安安静静地撕开，就是拆包；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语前缀 un-（表示相反或解除）+ 动词 wrap（缠绕；包裹）→ unwrap（解除包裹、拆开）。wrap 更早的来源不确定，不能追溯到确定的外语词根。

sensesIntro.en: Unwrap moves from taking rubbish paper off a present, to undoing a bandage, to opening a folded thing, and then metaphorically to revealing a secret or relaxing the mood.
sensesIntro.cn: unwrap 从拆去礼物的包装纸，到解开绷带，再到摊开折叠之物，最后引申为揭示秘密、放松心情。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fingers tearing the corner of a wrapper so the thing inside shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指撕开包装纸的一角，里面的东西露出来。

branches.en: Taking the paper or plastic off a present or parcel is the central everyday sense.
branches.cn: 拆去礼物或包裹外面的包装纸是中心义项。

branches.en: Removing a bandage keeps the winding picture but shifts the object to the body.
branches.cn: 解开绷带保留了缠绕的画面，只是对象换成了身体。

branches.en: Opening a folded map is the object unwrapping itself.
branches.cn: 摊开地图是物体自己「解开包裹」的义项。

branches.en: Revealing a secret transfers the covering image from paper to information.
branches.cn: 揭露秘密是把「覆盖物」由纸张转移到信息上的引申。

branches.en: Both a physical wrapper and emotional tension are layers that can be taken off.
branches.cn: 实物包装与情绪紧张都是可以被解开的「一层」。

intro.en: Unwrap is built from the reversing prefix un- and the verb wrap; its family includes wrapping, wrapper, and wrapped.
intro.cn: unwrap 由表示反向的前缀 un- 与动词 wrap 构成，同族词有 wrapping、wrapper、wrapped。

latinIntro.en: Neither wrap nor unwrap has a Latin root; un- is an English prefix from Old English, and the spelling of wrap with a silent w may reflect an earlier pronunciation.
latinIntro.cn: wrap 与 unwrap 都没有拉丁词根；un- 是来自古英语的英语前缀，wrap 中不发音的 w 可能保留了更早的读音痕迹。

items.meaningCN: 表示相反或解除动作的前缀
items.example: Un- turns lock into unlock.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 un- 把 lock 变成 unlock（开锁）。

items.meaning: to cover by folding material round
items.example: They wrap gifts in red paper.
items.exampleCN: 他们用红纸包礼物。

items.example: The vase arrived wrapped in cloth.
items.exampleCN: 花瓶送到时用布裹着。

items.meaning: paper or material used to cover something
items.example: Wrapping goes into the recycling bin.
items.exampleCN: 包装材料扔进回收箱。

items.meaning: a cover or paper round a product
items.example: The candy wrapper fell on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 糖纸掉在了地上。

items.example: Unwrapped food spoils faster.
items.exampleCN: 拆了包装的食物坏得更快。

items.meaning: the act of taking off a cover
items.example: Unwrapping gifts is the best part for children.
items.exampleCN: 拆礼物是孩子们最喜欢的一环。

items.example: Unzip uses the same reversing prefix.
items.exampleCN: unzip 用的是同一个反向前缀。

items.meaning: to take things out of a case
items.example: Unpack shares the idea of removing a cover.
items.exampleCN: unpack 同样表达「去掉外层」。

definition_zh: 不屈的；坚定的；不让步的；坚硬的；不弯曲的
definition_en: not willing to change an opinion, give way, or be defeated, or not bending or giving in to pressure
core_image: 一根钢柱压住千斤重物，弯了一下又弹直，始终不肯塌下去
scene: 谈判拖到深夜，双方谁都不肯退让半步。The negotiator stayed unyielding on the question of safety standards.
sceneCN: 这里 unyielding 是「不让步的」（第 1 个义项：在要求或压力下坚持立场）；句意：谈判代表在安全标准问题上寸步不让。

pos.zh: 不屈的；坚定的；不让步的
坚硬的；不弯曲的；有弹性的

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「屈服；让路；出产」；前缀 un- 与 -ing 构成其否定形态
yield 加 -ing 构成，义为「易弯曲的；顺从的」，与 unyielding 构成反义
同为 un- 构成的否定形容词，义为「不愿意的」，可与 unyielding 对照记忆
形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「坚决地；不让步地」

senses.title: Not giving way to demands
senses.definition: refusing to change a firm position or give in to pressure when asked
senses.definitionCN: 在被要求让步或承受压力时，坚持立场、拒绝改变
senses.example: The union was unyielding in its demand for safer hours.
senses.exampleCN: 工会在要求更安全的工作时间上毫不让步。
senses.why: To yield is to give way or surrender, so the negated participle unyielding describes someone who never gives way.
senses.whyCN: yield 意为让路、屈服，加上否定前缀与动词性词尾，unyielding 描述的就是「从不让路」的人。

senses.title: Firm in purpose
senses.definition: showing a determination that will not be weakened by difficulty or failure
senses.definitionCN: 展现出不为困难或失败所动摇的决心
senses.example: Her unyielding courage inspired the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她那不屈的勇气鼓舞了整个团队。
senses.why: The refusal to yield is turned inward, so the word praises an inner strength that does not break under hardship.
senses.whyCN: 「不让步」的对象由外转为内，这个词因此用来赞美在困难面前不会折断的内在力量。

senses.title: Not bending under force
senses.definition: not bending, stretching, or deforming when force is applied
senses.definitionCN: 受到外力时不弯曲、不拉伸、不变形
senses.example: The bridge rests on unyielding steel columns.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥架在不弯曲的钢柱上。
senses.why: Yield also means to bend or give way physically, so an unyielding material keeps its shape under load.
senses.whyCN: yield 也有物理意义上的「弯曲、变形」，所以 unyielding 的材料承重时能保持原有形状。

senses.title: Constant and reliable
senses.definition: steady and never weakening, as of support, effort, or attention
senses.definitionCN: 指支持、努力或关注一贯稳定、从不减弱
senses.example: Their unyielding support carried him through the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 他们坚定不移的支持陪他熬过了难关。
senses.why: A support that never yields, that is, never slackens, is described as unyielding in its steadiness.
senses.whyCN: 一种「从不用力减弱」的支持，就是始终如一的，unyielding 由此获得「持续可靠」的色彩。

senses.title: Too rigid to listen
senses.definition: so fixed in an opinion that no advice or evidence can move the person
senses.definitionCN: 看法固定到任何建议或证据都无法改变
senses.example: His unyielding view of the past closed every conversation.
senses.exampleCN: 他对过去那种死板的看法让每次交谈都无法继续。
senses.why: The same refusal to move becomes a fault when it is aimed at listening, so the word can carry a tone of stubbornness.
senses.whyCN: 同样是「不肯移动」，当对象变成「听取意见」时就成了缺点，于是这个词带上固执的贬义。

intro.en: Unyielding is an English formation: the reversed prefix un- plus yielding, the present participle of the verb yield, which has meant to pay, to give way, and to give up since Old English.
intro.cn: unyielding 是英语自行构成的词：反向词缀 un- 加上 yield 的现在分词 yielding；yield 从古英语起就有「付出、让路、交出」等义。

items.en: Gieldan means to pay or to repay a debt, and also to give back what is held.
items.cn: 古英语 gieldan 意为付款、还债，也指交还所持之物。

items.en: Yelden broadens to mean to give way to an opponent or to surrender.
items.cn: 中古英语 yelden 扩展到「向对手让路、屈服」的意思。

items.en: Yield also develops the physical sense of bending or giving under pressure.
items.cn: yield 又发展出物理义：在压力下弯曲、退让。

items.en: The adjective unyielding is formed with the reversing prefix un- and the participle -ing.
items.cn: 形容词 unyielding 由反向前缀 un- 与分词词尾 -ing 构成。

items.en: The word extends from stiff materials to firm resolve, and sometimes to stubbornness.
items.cn: 这个词从坚硬的材料扩展到坚定的意志，有时也带上固执的贬义。

note.en: Unyielding is built on the verb yield, so it stands beside yielding and yield in form, and beside firm, stubborn, and relentless in meaning.
note.cn: unyielding 以动词 yield 为核心（形，与 yielding、yield 形式相关；义，与 firm、stubborn、relentless 意义相邻）。

entries.definition: to give way, surrender, or produce a result
soft and bending easily, or ready to agree
entries.definitionCN: 易弯曲的；顺从的；与 unyielding 相反

entries.definition: not wanting to do something
strong and not likely to change
refusing to change an opinion even when wrong
never stopping or growing weaker

normalIntro.en: Unyielding reverses yield, the verb for giving way, so the word paints a force that never gives ground.
normalIntro.cn: unyielding 是 yield（让路）的反面，描绘的是一种从不让出地盘的力量。

normal.en: Remember un + yielding: without giving way.
normal.cn: 记成 un 加 yielding：没有「让路」。

normal.en: Yielding is the soft opposite, ready to bend or agree.
normal.cn: 反义的 yielding 是「柔软的、乐于让步的」。

normal.en: Unyielding support means help that never weakens.
normal.cn: unyielding support 指从不变弱的支持。

normal.en: In materials, to yield is to bend plastically, so unyielding steel does not bend.
normal.cn: 在材料学里 yield 指塑性变形，所以 unyielding 的钢材不会弯。

normal.en: The adjective only takes more and most, not -er and -est.
normal.cn: 这个形容词只用 more、most 构成比较级与最高级，不加 -er、-est。

abstract.en: Picture a stone pillar that a flood keeps pushing but never moves.
abstract.cn: 想象洪水一遍遍冲撞石柱，石柱却纹丝不动。

abstract.en: Imagine a rope pulled from both ends that never frays.
abstract.cn: 想象一根从两头被拉扯却始终不断的绳子。

abstract.en: Think of a clock hand that keeps pointing at one opinion.
abstract.cn: 想象一根指针始终指着同一个看法，不肯转动。

examples.en: Despite months of talks, both sides stayed unyielding on the border question.
examples.cn: 尽管谈了好几个月，双方在边界问题上仍寸步不让。

examples.en: The climbers faced an unyielding wall of ice.
examples.cn: 登山者面对的是一堵坚硬的冰墙。

examples.en: Her unyielding optimism never faded, even in the darkest year.
examples.cn: 即使在最艰难的那一年，她那坚定的乐观也从未消退。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安·乙尔丁」——像钉子一样安在乙字框里，怎么拔都拔不动，就是不肯屈服；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 gieldan（付款、偿还）→ 中古英语 yelden（让路、屈服）→ 英语 yield + 反向前缀 un- + 分词词尾 -ing → unyielding（不让步的）。

sensesIntro.en: Unyielding starts as a refusal to give way, then praises firm resolve, applies to stiff materials, describes steady support, and can finally turn into a mild criticism of stubbornness.
sensesIntro.cn: unyielding 先指不肯让路，继而用来赞美坚定的决心，再指坚硬的材质与持续的支持，最后可以带一点固执的贬义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steel column that bends under a huge load but springs back and never collapses.
core.cn: 核心意象：钢柱在重压下弯了一下又弹直，始终不肯塌下去。

branches.en: Refusing to give ground in a dispute is the central sense.
branches.cn: 在争执中不让步是中心义项。

branches.en: Inner resolve is the refusal applied to the spirit.
branches.cn: 内在的决心是「不让步」用到精神层面的义项。

branches.en: A material that does not bend is the physical sense.
branches.cn: 不弯曲的材料是物理义项。

branches.en: A position that never moves and support that never weakens share the same steadiness.
branches.cn: 不动摇的立场与不松懈的支持共享同一种稳定。

branches.en: The same refusal can be praised as firmness or blamed as stubbornness.
branches.cn: 同一种不肯让步既可以被赞为坚定，也可以被贬为固执。

intro.en: Unyielding is un- plus yielding, and its family includes yield, yielding, unyieldingly, and the negative adjective unwilling.
intro.cn: unyielding 由 un- 与 yielding 组成，同族词包括 yield、yielding、unyieldingly，以及同为否定形容词的 unwilling。

latinIntro.en: The yield family is Germanic rather than Latin: Old English gieldan, to pay, is the source of yield.
latinIntro.cn: yield 这一族词属于日耳曼语源而非拉丁语：古英语 gieldan（付款）是 yield 的来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示否定或相反的前缀
items.example: Un- turns yielding into unyielding.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 un- 把 yielding 变成 unyielding。

items.meaning: to give way, surrender, or produce
items.example: The door gave way, but the wall did not yield.
items.exampleCN: 门被推开了，墙却纹丝不动。

items.example: The mattress is soft and yielding.
items.exampleCN: 床垫柔软而有弹性。

items.example: She argued unyieldingly for the school.
items.exampleCN: 她为这所学校据理力争。

items.meaning: the stress at which a material starts to deform
items.meaningCN: 屈服点（材料开始变形的应力）
items.example: Steel with a high yield point holds its shape.
items.exampleCN: 屈服点高的钢材能保持形状。

items.meaningCN: 坚定不移的；不屈不挠的
items.example: Unbending shares the image of refusing to bend.
items.exampleCN: unbending 共享「不肯弯曲」的意象。

items.meaning: not able to bend or change
items.meaningCN: 不可弯曲的；不容变更的
items.example: Inflexible is a near twin of unyielding.
items.exampleCN: inflexible 是 unyielding 的近义双生词。

items.example: Unwilling uses the same negative prefix.
items.exampleCN: unwilling 使用同一个否定前缀。

items.meaning: forming an adjective from a verb
items.meaningCN: 把动词变成形容词的词尾

definition_zh: 升级；提高（等级、标准）；改善（条件）；使（顾客）升舱；升级版；提升；上坡
definition_en: to raise something such as a device, service, or job to a higher or better standard, or the better version of it that results
core_image: 一枚写着低等级的标签被撕下来，换上更高级别的新标签
scene: 手机系统提示有新版本，用户点下按钮等待更新完成。The phone finished the upgrade while she slept.
sceneCN: 这里 upgrade 是「升级（名词）」（第 4 个义项：更新后的更高版本或升级过程）；句意：她睡觉的时候，手机完成了系统升级。

pos.zh: 升级；提高；改善（条件）
升级；升级版；提升

derivatives.zh: upgrade 加 -able 构成，义为「可升级的」
前缀 down-（向下）替代 up- 构成的反义词，义为「降级」
基础名词，义为「等级；级别」；upgrade 由 up 与 grade 复合而成
过去分词转形容词，义为「已升级的」
现在分词转名词，义为「升级改造」

senses.title: To raise the standard or grade
senses.definition: to raise something to a higher grade, quality, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 把某物提升到更高的等级、质量或标准
senses.example: The company upgraded every office computer this spring.
senses.exampleCN: 公司今年春天升级了所有办公电脑。
senses.why: Grade is a rank or level, and up- points to a higher place, so to upgrade is to move something up from one grade to the next.
senses.whyCN: grade 是等级、级别，up- 表示向上，所以 upgrade 就是把某物从一个等级抬到更高的等级。

senses.title: To install a newer version
senses.definition: to replace software, hardware, or equipment with a newer and better version
senses.definitionCN: 用更新、更好的版本替换软件、硬件或设备
senses.example: You should upgrade the app before the old version stops working.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该在旧版本停用之前更新这款应用。
senses.why: Each software release is numbered like a grade, so installing the next release repeats the up-plus-grade image of climbing one rank.
senses.whyCN: 每个软件版本都像等级一样编号，安装新版本就重复了「向上爬一级」的画面。

senses.title: To improve conditions
senses.definition: to improve the conditions, status, or pay attached to a job, place, or service
senses.definitionCN: 改善工作、场所或服务所附带的条件、地位或薪酬
senses.example: The council upgraded the shelter to a proper clinic.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会把临时收容点升级成了正规诊所。
senses.why: The rank picture widens from objects to living conditions, so a place or job is lifted into a better class.
senses.whyCN: 等级的画面从物品扩展到生活条件，于是场所或岗位被抬进更好的类别。

senses.title: The improved version or act
senses.definition: the act of upgrading, or the newer and better version that results from it
senses.definitionCN: 升级的行为，或升级后得到的更新更好的版本
senses.example: The upgrade fixed most of the crashes.
senses.exampleCN: 这次升级修复了大部分的崩溃问题。
senses.why: English often turns a verb of change into a noun, so the act of moving up a grade and the better version both take the name upgrade.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把表示变化的动词转成名词，所以「升一级」这一动作和升出来的新版本都叫 upgrade。

senses.title: To receive a better seat or room
senses.definition: to give a passenger or guest a better class of seat, room, or service than was paid for
senses.definitionCN: 给乘客或客人提供比所付价格更好的舱位、房间或服务
senses.example: The airline upgraded us to business class.
senses.exampleCN: 航空公司把我们免费升到了商务舱。
senses.why: A ticket is bought at a certain grade, and moving the traveller up a grade turns the rank image into a reward.
senses.whyCN: 机票是按等级购买的，把旅客往上提一个等级，就把等级的意象变成了奖赏。

senses.title: An upward slope
senses.definition: a slope that rises and becomes ever steeper, used in technical writing
senses.definitionCN: 向上逐渐变陡的坡面，多见于技术性描述
senses.example: The engineers measured the upgrade along the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师测量了山坡上的那段上升坡面。
senses.why: This older railway or engineering sense keeps up literal, so an upgrade is simply ground that goes upward.
senses.whyCN: 这个较早的铁路或工程义项把 up 当作字面方向，于是 upgrade 就是一段向上走的坡。

intro.en: Upgrade is a compound of up, from Old English, and grade, from Latin gradus, a step. It first named a rising slope, then rose some grades to its modern sense of improving or promoting.
intro.cn: upgrade 由古英语 up 与拉丁语 gradus（台阶）来源的 grade 复合而成；它先指向上倾斜的坡段，后来「升了几级」，才发展为现代「提升、升级」的意思。

items.en: Up comes from Old English up, meaning toward a higher position.
items.cn: up 来自古英语 up，意为「朝更高的位置」。

items.en: Gradus means a step or a rank, and gives English grade.
items.cn: 拉丁语 gradus 意为台阶、等级，是英语 grade 的来源。

items.en: Railway and engineering writing first uses upgrade for an upward slope or rising grade.
items.cn: 十九世纪的铁路与工程文献首先用 upgrade 指上坡或升高坡段。

items.en: The sense shifts to raising something to a higher grade or class, as in jobs and housing.
items.cn: 词义转向把事物提升到更高等级或等级更高的类别，如职业与住房。

items.en: Computing gives upgrade the everyday sense of installing a newer and better version.
items.cn: 计算机时代使 upgrade 固定为日常义「安装更新更好的版本」。

note.en: Upgrade is built from grade, with the directional prefix up-, so it stands beside grade, downgrade, and regrade in form, and beside improve, update, and promote in meaning.
note.cn: upgrade 以 grade（等级）为核心，加上方向前缀 up-；形式上与 grade、downgrade、regrade 相关，意义上与 improve、update、promote 相邻。

entries.definition: a rank, level, or standard of quality
to lower a person or thing to a lower grade
able to be improved to a higher grade
to make something better
to add the latest information or changes
to move someone to a higher position at work

normalIntro.en: Upgrade is grade with up in front: take a thing one grade higher.
normalIntro.cn: upgrade 就是把 up 放在 grade 前面：让某物高一等。

normal.en: Grade is a rank, so upgrade means one rank higher.
normal.cn: grade 是等级，upgrade 就是高出一级。

normal.en: Downgrade is the mirror word, made with down instead of up.
normal.cn: downgrade 是镜像词，把 up 换成 down 而成。

normal.en: Software upgrade keeps the noun and verb spelling the same.
normal.cn: software upgrade 提醒你：这个词名词与动词拼写完全相同。

normal.en: To be upgraded to business class uses toward, showing the move up a class.
normal.cn: be upgraded to business class 用 to 表示「升到」某个等级。

normal.en: Gradus in Latin means a step, so every upgrade is a step up.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 gradus 意为台阶，所以每次 upgrade 都是往上一个台阶。

abstract.en: Picture an old label being peeled off and a shinier one stuck on.
abstract.cn: 想象旧标签被撕下来，换上一枚更闪亮的新标签。

abstract.en: Imagine an elevator button marked with a higher floor lighting up.
abstract.cn: 想象电梯上更高楼层的按钮亮了起来。

abstract.en: Think of a seedling putting out one more leaf each season.
abstract.cn: 想象幼苗每一季都多长出一片叶子。

examples.en: We upgraded the old printer because it jammed every day.
examples.cn: 因为旧打印机天天卡纸，我们把它换新了。

examples.en: The hotel offered a free upgrade to a room with a sea view.
examples.cn: 酒店免费把房间升级成了海景房。

examples.en: The upgrade took twenty minutes and fixed three bugs.
examples.cn: 这次升级用了二十分钟，修复了三个缺陷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿普·格瑞德」——往上（up）爬一个等级（grade），就是升级；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 up（向上）+ 拉丁语 gradus（台阶、等级）→ 英语 grade → upgrade（升一级；升级；提升）。

sensesIntro.en: Upgrade starts with raising something to a higher grade, then applies that to new software versions, better living conditions, and the version that results, and finally to a ticket or room of a better class, with an older slope sense surviving in technical writing.
sensesIntro.cn: upgrade 先指把事物提升到更高等级，再用于新软件版本、更好的生活条件，以及升级后产物的含义；接着用于更好的舱位或房间，最后在技术文献中保留「上坡」这一较早的义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old low-grade label is taken off and a higher-grade one is stuck on.
core.cn: 核心意象：撕下低等级标签，贴上一枚更高的等级标签。

branches.en: Raising a thing one grade is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把事物提升一个等级是中心义项。

branches.en: Installing a newer version repeats the grade image in software.
branches.cn: 安装新版本是等级意象在软件中的重复。

branches.en: Better conditions lift a place or job into a higher class.
branches.cn: 更好的条件把场所或岗位抬进更高的类别。

branches.en: The upgraded result becomes a noun for the act or the new version.
branches.cn: 升级的结果转为名词，既指升级行为也指新版本。

branches.en: Giving a traveller a better seat moves a person up a grade by reward.
branches.cn: 给旅客更好的座位，是把人按奖赏往上提一个等级。

intro.en: Upgrade combines the directional up- and the noun grade, with parallel forms downgrade, upgradable, and the graded family.
intro.cn: upgrade 由方向前缀 up- 与 grade 合成，平行形式有 downgrade、upgradable 以及 grade 一族词。

latinIntro.en: The core of upgrade is Latin gradus, a step, which also gives gradual, graduate, and degrade, while up- is native English.
latinIntro.cn: upgrade 的核心是拉丁语 gradus（台阶），它也构成 gradual、graduate、degrade；而 up- 是英语本土的外缀。

items.example: Up- in upgrade points upward.
items.exampleCN: upgrade 中的 up- 指向向上。

items.example: Down- makes the mirror word downgrade.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 down- 构成镜像词 downgrade。

items.meaning: a rank or level of quality
items.example: Coffee is sold by grade.
